map.总尾数 1000 尾、面积 1 亩：放养密度 = 1000 / 1 = 1000: With 1000 fish over an area of 1 mu: stocking density = 1000 / 1 = 1000 fish/mu, about 1.5 fish/m² (1 mu ≈ 666.67 m²). In practice decide it together with species, size and aeration capacity.
map.由鱼种、目标规格、水深、增氧与换水能力共同决定；密度越高单产越高但风险越大，须匹: It is jointly determined by the species, target size, water depth, aeration and water-exchange capacity; a higher density raises yield but also risk, and must match the oxygen supply and waste-removal capacity.
map.尾/亩和尾/m² 怎么换算？: How do I convert fish/mu and fish/m²?
